title: Bug: Leakage detection feature broken by newly changes
author: yuazhe
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

the change https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-platform-daemons/pull/776 introduces 2 issues:
1. the legacy leak_status field had been removed, instead, the leaking had been used, this db scheme is not aligned with HLD anymore, causes CLI and system-health failure since they still looking for the leak_status field
2. during initialization, there isn't any prevent of non-implemented API such as get_leak_sensor_type and get_leak_sensor_location, the FieldValuePairs does NOT accpet None as parameter which causes thread directly crash.

### Steps to Reproduce

the problem is 100% reproduce, on liquid cooling system the CLI will report liquid cooling not detected.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

feature should work as before

### Relevant log output

```shell

```

### Output of `show version`, `show techsupport`

```shell

```

### Attach files (if any)

_No response_

comments.author: fraserg-arista
comments.body:
1. this was done to follow the pmon HLD, which names the field `device_leak_status`:  https://github.com/sonic-net/SONiC/blob/master/doc/bmc/sonicBMC/pmon-bmc-design.md#2221-db-schema -- I'm not seeing `leak_status` in the pmon HLD or leak detection HLD; is it defined somewhere? If the bug is in the HLD, we should fix that first.
2. I can change these to default to 'unknown' if not specified.

comments.author: yuazhe
comments.body:
@fraserg-arista  thanks for the quick response
1. The leak_status field is used to covert the leaking value, either 1 or 0 to user friendly Yes and No. Besides, the default value of it is N/A, so it prevents in some case when leak sensor is not readable due to hardware failure, user will get the exact information. It's not stated in the HLD since it's a implementation. I saw your PR removed this part of logic, and it causes the CLI not work any more.
Please keep this logic there, incase you have other thought.
2. agree, please do so.

comments.author: yuazhe
comments.body: @fraserg-arista  @judyjoseph I didn't see you address the point one, namely keep the logic related to leak_status field. Please be aware that this field is critical for CLI and system-health to work.

comments.author: judyjoseph
comments.body:
@yuazhe , not seeing where is leak_status being used .. we have tried to keep the same DB fields as in the earlier HLD : https://github.com/sonic-net/SONiC/blob/master/doc/bmc/leakage_detection_hld.md#stat_db-data-schema

https://github.com/sonic-net/SONiC/blob/master/doc/bmc/sonicBMC/pmon-bmc-design.md#2221-db-schema

comments.author: yuazhe
comments.body: @judyjoseph  like I said this is an implementation trick, the value for leaking is 1 or 0, so this field can convert it to user friendly yes and no. On top of it, it prevented when sensor is not readable the default value is N/A, neither 1 or 0 so user will get clear information that the sensor is missing. Please refer to the code here https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-platform-daemons/pull/776/changes#diff-1cdec918e50d6e11322c04e9a1e26276b90ce6d3783d6af4df5218c7f0958bddL551-L566

comments.author: judyjoseph
comments.body: @yuazhe we have added the leak_status field back here : https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-platform-daemons/pull/818, Can you check this commit : https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-platform-daemons/pull/818/changes/20bfee5b0a035e03641140972fa7eda4a68f8f1a
